text:
Emma (Sales): Hey team — incoming SIG/CAIQ from BlueRiver Logistics for the upcoming POC. They attached the questionnaire and want answers by next Wed. Link: https://drive.redwood/blue-river/sig-2026.pdf. Can Security own the intake and let me know if we need any customer-signed docs? :eyes:
IntakeBot: New vendor questionnaire received. Routing to #vendor-risk queue. Ticket VR-2026-114 created and assigned to untriaged.
Josh (Security): I can pick this up. Quick skim: they ask for SOC2 report, pen test summary, KMS/HSM key custody, and network segmentation diagrams. Any red flags on PII or HIPAA on the POc scope?
Sara (Customer Success): POC touches shipment tracking data (no health info). They may provide contact names and adr. Not HIPAA. Could be sensitive commercial data — request NDA?
Emma (Sales): We already have the standard NDA in our SFDC opportunity attachments. I can push the signed copy if Security/Legal want it attached. Timeline: customer wants answers inline by 2026-06-02 (next Wed).
Oliver (Legal): Please attach the NDA. Also note they asked about subprocessor list and data residency — if they insist on EU residency we need to escalate.
Josh (Security): Thanks. I'll triage question types and draft canned answers. Plan: 1) provide SOC2 summary + link to attestations 2) attach pen-test executive summary 3) answer CAIQ/SIG inline with references to our control docs 4) indicate KMS options (customer-managed or Redwood KMS with HSM-backed keys).
Josh (Security): Proposing we produce two artifacts: (A) completed CAIQ spreadsheet (inline answers), (B) short cover memo summarizing where docs live. Draft snippet below for the KMS question:
```
Q: Do you support customer-managed keys or HSM-backed key custody?
A: Redwood supports both options. For hosted deployments we offer HSM-backed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can enable customer-managed keys for Dedicated or Private deployments. We provide key rotation guidance and audit logs. Contact security@redwood.com for deployment-specific details.
```
Emma (Sales): That looks good. Please mark items we cannot confirm (e.g., third-party subprocessors list) so I can follow up with Procurement.
Josh (Security): Noted. I'll flag any items that need Legal or Product input. Assigning to myself and setting due date 2026-06-02. Will post the CAIQ draft in this thread when ready. :white_check_mark:
IntakeBot: Ticket VR-2026-114 updated: owner=josh_security, due=2026-06-02, priority=high.
Oliver (Legal): If they request contractual changes (data residency SLA or subprocessor constraints), escalate to me and include the opportunity ID.
Josh (Security): Draft uploaded: https://drive.redwood/blue-river/VR-2026-114-caiaq-draft.xlsx. Please review: Sara (CS) for scope accuracy, Oliver (Legal) for any contractual flags.
Sara (Customer Success): Reviewing now. I can confirm scope — PII limited to contact info. No PHI.
Emma (Sales): Thanks everyone — I'm adding the timeline to the opportunity and will let the customer know we're on it. :thumbsup:
